subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should `claws export` remain a healthy-exact-state operation only, or should it support an explicitly requested degraded snapshot format with drift and lineage metadata?
rationale: The code and docs choose failure on drift, while the supplied product discussion argues that partial exports may be valuable only when clearly marked; this is a durable package and user-expectation contract, not a mechanical review repair.

options.title: Require healthy exact state by default
options.body: Keep export fail-closed for missing, drifted, or partial managed state and document it as a reproducible-role export.

options.title: Add explicit snapshot mode
options.body: Permit degraded exports only behind a named mode that emits machine-readable drift, source identity, and completeness information.

options.title: Defer export contract
options.body: Pause this stacked feature until the RFC or owner direction defines the portable-package semantics.

recommendation.title: Require healthy exact state by default
recommendation.body: Keep export fail-closed for missing, drifted, or partial managed state and document it as a reproducible-role export.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest available history connection to the current Claw lifecycle/export contract; the final acceptance still requires an authorized maintainer decision.
